outcome.answer: The matching paper is “Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation” by Woosung Koh and coauthors [1]. It introduces Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), which uses a minimally larger, same-family aligner to provide supervision for small models’ continual learning, combined with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling [1]. The paper reports that SynthSelf outperforms six compared methods across three small-model scales and evaluates both learning new capabilities and retaining prior knowledge [1].
